t: The first thing checked, and what covers the gap
a: انْظُرُوا، هَلْ تَجِدُونَ لِعَبْدِي مِنْ تَطَوُّعٍ؟ فَأَكْمِلُوا بِهَا مَا ضَيَّعَ مِنْ فَرِيضَتِهِ
p: Unẓurū, hal tajidūna li-ʿabdī min taṭawwuʿ, fa-akmilū bihā mā ḍayyaʿa min farīḍatih
m: Look, do you find any voluntary prayers for My servant? Then complete with them whatever he let slip of his obligation.
